fact: 福特T型车（Model T）于1908年秋在底特律Piquette Avenue工厂开始生产：Graces Guide记载首辆生产型T型车1908年8月12日投产、9月27日出厂；History.com则记为1908年10月1日完成第一辆生产型T型车（两来源日期不一致，指向同一投产窗口）。该车设计团队包括Childe Harold Wills与两名匈牙利移民Joseph A. Galamb、Eugene Farkas。

sources.title: Graces Guide — Ford: Model T
sources.quote: 1908 The first production Model T was produced in the US on August 12, 1908 and left the factory on September 27, 1908, at the Piquette Plant in Detroit, Michigan. The Ford Model T car was designed by Childe Harold Wills and two Hungarian immigrants, Joseph A. Galamb and Eugene Farkas.

sources.title: History.com — Ford Motor Company unveils the Model T
sources.quote: On October 1, 1908, the first production Model T Ford is completed at the company's Piquette Avenue plant in Detroit. Between 1908 and 1927, Ford would build some 15 million Model T cars.

fact: 1908年9月16日，威廉·杜兰特（William C. Durant）将通用汽车公司（General Motors）注册成立，总部位于密歇根州弗林特，最初是别克（Buick）的控股公司；同年11月12日奥兹莫比尔（Olds Motor Works）并入。1908年别克产量已超过福特与凯迪拉克之和，杜兰特用四年时间从最大马车制造商变成最大汽车制造商。

sources.title: General Motors 官方企业史 — GM Founder William Durant's Story
sources.quote: In 1908, Buick production surpassed Ford and Cadillac combined. Durant had made the transition from the largest carriage maker to the largest automobile manufacturer in a little more than three years. ... They agreed, and General Motors was incorporated on September 16, 1908.

sources.title: CompaniesHistory.com — General Motors History
sources.quote: 1908 William C. Durant founded General Motors Company on September 16 in Flint, Michigan, as a holding company for Buick. Durant had previously become the largest manufacturer of horse-drawn vehicles before entering the automotive industry.

sources.title: Shiawassee Historical Society — Important General Motors Dates
sources.quote: 1908 General Motors Company is organized in 1908 (Sept 16), incorporating the Buick Motor Company. Oldsmobile becomes the second company to join General Motors when Olds Motor Works is sold to GM on Nov. 12, 1908.

fact: 1908年2月12日，由《纽约时报》与巴黎《费加罗报》系小报《Le Matin》联合赞助的纽约—巴黎跨国汽车赛在纽约时代广场出发，德、法、意、美六支车队参赛；美国队的Thomas Flyer（1907年款，4缸60马力）于1908年7月30日傍晚6时抵达巴黎夺冠，全程三大洲、超过22,000英里、历时169天，是美国汽车工业首次在国际长途耐力赛中压过欧洲列强的标志性事件。

sources.title: Automotive Hall of Fame — George N. Schuster
sources.quote: It was 1908 when an American-built Thomas Flyer won the New York-to-Paris Automobile race. The "Great Auto Race of 1908" was an international competition. Six cars entered with teams representing Germany, Italy, France and the United States. ... Starting on February 12, 1908, the New York to Paris race took them through Albany, Chicago, San Francisco, Seattle, Valdez, Alaska, then to Japan, and on to Vladivostok, Omsk, Moscow, St. Petersburg in Russia, and finally Berlin and Paris. ... Schuster and the Thomas Flyer team arrived in Paris at 6 pm on July 30. The Thomas Flyer covered three continents and over 22,000 miles in only 169 days.

sources.quote: The Great Automobile Race of 1908, sponsored by The New York Times and Le Matin, the Parisian newspaper, featured national teams from Germany, France, Italy and the United States. The race, from New York to Paris, ran through three continents

fact: 1908年，底特律的凯迪拉克成为第一家赢得英国皇家汽车俱乐部（RAC）德瓦尔奖杯（Dewar Trophy）的美国汽车品牌：三辆Cadillac Model K被拆散、零件混装、再用库存件重新装配并继续行驶，通过标准化/互换性测试，为“互换零件=现代汽车大批量生产之基础”提供了公开验证，凯迪拉克由此启用“Standard of the World”口号。

sources.title: Wikipedia — Cadillac
sources.quote: Cadillac had the first U.S. car to win the Royal Automobile Club of the United Kingdom's Dewar Trophy by successfully demonstrating the interchangeability of its component parts during a reliability test in 1908; this spawned the firm's slogan "Standard of the World". It won the trophy again in 1912 for incorporating electric starting and lighting in a production automobile. ... Cadillac participated in the 1908 interchangeability test in the United Kingdom, and was awarded the Dewar Trophy for the most important advancement of the year in the automobile industry.

sources.title: motogallery.com — 1909–1911 Cadillac Model Thirty: History & Specs
sources.quote: In the Royal Automobile Club's 1908 interchangeability trial, three Model K Cadillacs were dismantled, their parts mixed, and the cars reassembled with stock components before completing further running. That demonstration earned the Dewar Trophy and supplied unusually concrete evidence for Cadillac's slogan, "The Standard of the World".

fact: 1908年，塞尔登“道路发动机”专利（US 549,160，1895年获准）仍由特许汽车制造商协会（ALAM）体系执行：造车者须获得许可并缴纳版税；福特公司1903年申请许可被拒后选择拒绝加入并继续生产，ALAM、塞尔登与Electric Vehicle Company随后对其提起专利侵权诉讼，1909年5月28日开庭、同年9月15日一审判决支持塞尔登方，福特上诉至1911年1月才获联邦上诉法院改判。1908年推出T型车的福特正处在这一诉讼风暴的前夜。

fact: T型车于1908年末投产后连续生产至1927年，累计产量约1,500万辆；1913年福特引入移动装配线把整车制造时间压缩（到1914年约93分钟/辆），1914年1月福特宣布日薪5美元——1908年的“低成本四缸大众车+后来的流水线”路线被证明是20世纪初最成功的产品与生产组织方式。

His introduction of the moving assembly line in 1913 brought prices down, making the Model T affordable for many working class individuals. Among them were his own employees, who in 1914 had their wage almost doubled to $5 a day. ... In 1926 Ford produced its 15 millionth Model T.

fact: 1907年10月纽约信托公司挤兑（10月22日Knickerbocker Trust在被提走近800万美元后停业、1908年3月增资240万美元后复业）演变成全国性金融危机；1908年美国工业产出下降17%、实际GNP下降12%。作为应对，国会于1908年5月30日通过《奥尔德里奇—弗里兰法》（Aldrich-Vreeland Act），授权发行紧急货币并设立国家货币委员会（National Monetary Commission），后者的研究最终导向1913年联邦储备法。1908年的美国金融业处在“没有中央银行、靠私人银行家救火”的制度空窗期。

The next day, after depositors had withdrawn nearly $8 million, it suspended operations. ... It reopened in March 1908 following the infusion of $2.4 million in new capital. ... Industrial output fell 17 percent in 1908, and real GNP fell by 12 percent.

fact: 1908联邦财年获准入境的移民为782,870—782,873人（NBER表列783千人；《Paths of Integration》移民统计表列782,870人），较1907财年约112万人的峰值明显回落——1907年金融危机后的经济萧条直接压缩了入境规模；同期另有约92.5万人离境。美国当时尚无识字测试等限制性移民法（1917年才立法），入境管制仍以“公共负担”审查为主。

fact: 1914年1月福特宣布“五美元日薪”之前，底特律汽车业非熟练工的日均工资约为2.40美元，福特公司最低工资约2.70美元——1908年前后的汽车厂工资略高于一般城市劳工但远未达到后来的5美元水平；1914年日薪翻倍至5美元是对整个底特律劳动力市场的冲击性提价。

The minimum wage at the Ford Motor Company stood at around $2.70 ("Compiling of Rates," S.S. Marquis Papers, Acc. 293).

fact: 底特律在1900—1910年间由全国第13大城市（1900年285,704人）跃升至第9大城市（1910年465,766人），六成以上新增人口来自外来移民与周边迁入，且“1900—1919年的大规模移民潮在很大程度上是汽车工业增长的结果”；汽车制造从业人数从1904年的2,034人增至1909年的17,400人、1914年的约60,000人——1908年的底特律正处在技能型工人极度短缺、同乡移民网络快速扩张的窗口期。
